roles.summary: Small evaluations of agent and model behaviour, published with code, data and preregistrations.
highlights: diffing-agent-bench: a sealed, preregistered benchmark for black-box model-diffing agents. In 13 attempts my implementation of a published recipe never asked the database question that would have found the planted database preference; a prompt battery I wrote, with database questions in it, found it for $0.15 in one run.

IncidentGate (closed at a baseline, Sep 2026): a test harness for an incident-response agent. On one scripted scenario, three approval-required calls passed a local 14B monitor and a scripted approver, and the forbidden state landed.

ProofPack: an evidence-gated pre-approval reviewer at $0.02 to $0.19 of Gemini per review across seven synthetic sample forms, now with a localhost reviewer workbench that streams the agent's trail and re-hashes every capture against the manifest on demand.
Two Apart Research sprints: the Digital Grimace Scale (Digital Minds, Aug 2026) and whose-voice (Secret Loyalties, Jul 2026) — both published with their failed tests intact.

roles.summary: Built backends and LLM systems for startup clients in the US, Canada, Europe and Australia.
highlights: Natural-language real-estate search: a FastAPI service turning plain-English queries into SQL over Cloud SQL via GPT-3.5, deployed on GCP Cloud Run and load-tested with Locust.
DocuAI semantic document search: chunked and indexed 1000+ documents in Qdrant and returned the most relevant parent documents; designed the ingestion schema and retrieval logic.
Speech-assessment backend for an EdTech client: scored one-minute candidate videos with Whisper ASR and the Microsoft Pronunciation API on AWS Fargate, tuned against ground truth.
FinBot: Mistral-7B fine-tuned with QLoRA plus an Alpaca to Bytewax to Qdrant news-retrieval pipeline, served with vLLM on a GKE L4 GPU node.

open_source.what: Refactored the backend and added OpenAI provider support to a privacy-first meeting-notes tool.
Proposed a cosine-similarity connector-template recommender over element name and type as a lightweight alternative to LLM function calls.
The working SentenceTransformer implementation of the recommender proposed in bpmn-io/refactorings#33.
